description: sfxnz's two-DGX-Spark vLLM TP2 kit (head 3de91468, 2026-09-27, no upstream release tag) for its EXL3 2.0 bpw pack of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, branch 2.0bpw-mcg-viterbi-lmhead-mxfp8 (snapshot 982b7045, 357 GB on the Hub, which upstream calls 334 GB: routed experts re-encoded with tail-biting Viterbi plus a scale refit, lm_head in MXFP8, Engram tables on NVMe read from the same pack), on the digest-pinned vllm/vllm-openai:deepseekv41-flash-0909 arm64 image. Upstream's docker/Dockerfile steps and its whole docker/patch directory are baked byte-identically at the paths run.sh bind-mounts; its boot-time vLLM source rewrites are pre-applied at build because the Vonk root is read-only. Upstream defaults: DSpark k=3 with matched CUDA graph sizes, fp8 KV pinned to 8 GiB, native 1,048,576-token window, two sequences (upstream refuses more), 8192-token prefill chunks, vision on, thinking off by default with reasoning effort low (clients can override chat_template_kwargs). The image also contains selectable P2B modes off, cooperative, and dataflow; dataflow remains the upstream round-35 default. Upstream claims (measured on its own two Sparks, not measured here): 42.6 tok/s real-use prose and 50.4 tok/s prose at concurrency 1, 33.2 tok/s before its round-35 kernel bundle. Memory: the 108 GB per-node peak is derived from upstream's only figure (21.6 and 23.2 GiB free per Spark after a 32k prefill; Mia's sibling recipe on the same base declares 119 GB), not measured here. First-use kernels (native Engram staging, dense GEMV) compile into container temp space; DSV41_DROP_PAGE_CACHE cannot write drop_caches unprivileged, so that lever is untested here. DSV41_PATCH_STRICT stays on, so a required boot-time rewrite that no longer matches aborts the rank. Not exposed: upstream's post-ready engagement audit and warmup script (host-side run.sh steps), the unsafe-override switches, and its SSH orchestration. Licences are information only: kit scripts MIT (upstream LICENSE), DeepSeek weights MIT, the vllm-exl3 plugin the image builds is AGPL-3.0 per upstream. Vonk physical acceptance is pending.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash EXL3 2.0 bpw sfxnz vLLM two Sparks
